Metadata.title: RESolare — The Italian solar marketplace
Metadata.description: Buy and sell free land, RTB projects, plants at COD, operating PV plants and revamping & repowering opportunities. Rooftop, ground-mount and BESS.

Hero.tagline: The vertical solar marketplace in Italy
Hero.title: Land, RTB projects, COD and operating plants. All in one place.
Hero.subtitle: We connect landowners, developers and investors without intermediaries. Post for free or sell with our premium support.

Featured.sectionSubtitle: Indicative examples of the projects you'll find on RESolare. Sign up to be the first to see the real ones.

Categories.sectionSubtitle: From free space to revamping. RESolare covers the entire solar asset lifecycle, available across rooftop, ground-mount and BESS.
Categories.areaDescription: Agricultural, industrial or brownfield areas without permits. For owners who want to monetize their land.
Categories.rtbDescription: Ready-to-Build projects or in advanced permit stage, with grid connection quote and feasibility studies.
Categories.codDescription: Turnkey plants under construction or just commissioned. For buyers seeking a ready-to-produce asset.
Categories.operatingDescription: Operating PV plants ready for sale. With or without GSE incentives, on rooftops, ground-mount or agrivoltaic.
Categories.revampingDescription: Modernization and repowering interventions on existing plants. Module/inverter replacement, yield optimization.
